correctness.rationale: Dihedral symmetrization is exact for SLEM because the spectral norm is convex. The stated radial/Fourier matrices are derived by an orthonormal representation, with \(a=1/n\), \(b=(n-1)/(2n)\) leaving exactly the stated self-loops. The first Fourier positive eigenvalue is a universal strict lower bound for invariant chains and is minimized at the two row constraints. The radial-versus-Fourier comparison follows from rational inequalities for \(n=11\) and monotone cubic for all \(n\ge12\); \(n=10\) has the opposite strict comparison and a directional improvement in b. Exact rational certificates and direct finite dense spectra were recomputed from the files. No unrestricted uniqueness or small-size complete solution is claimed.

value.rationale: The gear graph models inserting relays on a wheel rim. Its three vertex orbits create a genuine competition between radial and rim Fourier spectral modes. The result identifies a sharp natural integer cutoff (11) after which hub and primary-rim holding probabilities vanish, gives exact globally optimal weights for an infinite family, and quantifies a nonvanishing asymptotic 14% spectral-gap advantage over maximum-degree weighting. This is an exact topology/weight classification, not a parameter re-labeling or an arbitrary small-table entry.
